input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Admin, User roles. It manages core business objects including transaction msg, transaction msg adapter, user role, role entity. The platform provides capabilities for message codec, hessian codec, kryo codec. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage transaction msg records, so that I can track and organize transaction msg data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage transaction msg adapter records, so that I can track and organize transaction msg adapter data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage user role records, so that I can track and organize user role data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage role entity records, so that I can track and organize role entity data effectively.
